summary: cinatra#3745: adds agent_run_outward_action_policies (a run's one bound step-tool graph: run, org, execution attempt, policy) and artifact_review_action_consumptions (a burned artifact-review gate: gate, run, org, step, tool identity, executed source hash; no cascade, so deleting a gate or run never re-admits it), and two nullable columns on artifact_review_resume_outbox: run_claimed_at (the resume delivery's claim mark) and resume_task_result (its send witness). ADDITIVE ONLY: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS; no row is written or backfilled, so no authority is fabricated. Mirrors the idempotent bootstrap twins outwardActionPolicySchemaQueries and lifecycleInterceptionsSchemaQueries (src/lib/artifacts/artifact-review-gate-schema.ts) and the Drizzle tables in packages/agents/src/schema.ts, shipped in the same pull request. A guard refuses only a database whose ledger holds a migration name of an unreleased draft of this change (core__0115_agent-run-outward-action-policy, core__0116_resume-intent-run-claim): such a boot needs CINATRA_3745_DRAFT_DB_ACK=workers-stopped, and then refuses while any intent of a running run carries no claim mark (delivering or dead-lettered), naming agent_run_stop. down() throws. SEQ 0120 was chosen above the highest sequence on main and above every sequence that the pushed heads of the other open changes held when this change was first pushed. 0115 and 0116 are the sequences that an unreleased draft of this change used; the guard reads those two draft names, not the sequences.
